name: Dranik’s Scar: North
summary: A frigid ridge overlooking the canyon, dominated by Muramite overwatch forces and Discord frost winds.
description: Scar North is a cold, jagged ridge carved upward toward the canyon’s highest cliffs. Discord frost winds sweep across the stone, creating sudden temperature drops and arcane instability. Muramite overwatch squads use elevated ledges to monitor Dragorn resistance movement, while Dragorn ridge‑runners traverse narrow paths to avoid detection. The terrain is brittle, frost‑scarred, and strategically vital for controlling the canyon’s upper routes.
